MetricCoordinate.description:
Where one coordinate label sits on its axis.

A host sorts by `group` and then by `value`, so maturity and strike order
is not recovered by parsing label text.

group.description:
Text the value is scoped by: the `{surface}::` of a vega row, empty for
a bare tenor or strike, and the whole label when it carries no number.

value.description:
Tenor in years (`3m` is 0.25, per [`parse_key_rate_label`]) or the
decimal strike; `None` when the label carries no number.

MetricUnit.description:
Unit family of a metric value.

The classification follows the unit documented on each `MetricId`
constant. Currency-per-bump sensitivities (`dv01`, `cs01`, `vega`) are
reported as [`MetricUnit::Currency`]: the value is a currency amount and
the bump is part of the metric's definition, not of its unit.

oneOf.description:
Amount in the result currency (PV components, currency-per-bump
sensitivities, Greeks scaled by notional, jump-to-default).

Decimal rate, probability, fraction or spread (`0.05` = 5%,
`0.01` = 100bp).

Years (durations, WAL/WAM, time to maturity, calendar-day counts
expressed in years).

Percent or percentage-point value (`5.0` = 5%), such as a price quoted
as a percentage of par.

Pure number: ratios, multiples, counts, discount factors, flags, epoch
days, index levels, and FX rates.

Custom metric or a standard metric whose unit depends on the producing
calculator.

description: Canonical per-key metric interpretation for host presentation.

bucketed.description: Whether this is a DV01/CS01 bucket with nonempty identifier and bucket coordinates.

components.description: Decoded coordinate labels in original order; empty for scalar metrics.

coordinates.description: How each entry of `components` orders along its axis, aligned with it.

group.description:
Native display group, the same name [`metrics_for_instrument`] lists the
base metric under; absent for a base metric the standard registry does
not hold.

key.description: Original canonical wire key, retained without renaming.

metric.description: Base metric name without composite coordinates.

unit.description: Native unit family; custom or calculator-dependent units remain unknown.
